content.title: China Ends Levies on US Farm Goods, Halts Export Curbs on Firms
content.summary: The country’s Finance Ministry confirmed in a Wednesday notice it would end tariffs imposed March 4 on soybeans and other US agricultural products including corn, wheat, sorghum and chicken.  Hours later, the Commerce Ministry said it would remove 15 American firms from an export control list, while taking 10 other US companies off its unreliable entity list.  Beijing will also scrap a ban on Illumina Inc.’s exports of its DNA sequencer to China.
